name: What is carbon monoxide safety in a laundry room with gas appliances?

mainEntity.name: What is carbon monoxide safety in a laundry room with gas appliances?

acceptedAnswer.text: Carbon monoxide (CO) safety in a laundry room with gas appliances primarily involves ensuring proper ventilation and installing CO detectors. Gas dryers, water heaters, or furnaces can produce CO if not properly vented, leading to a silent, odorless, and potentially fatal gas leak. Regular inspection of exhaust flues for blockages or damage is critical. Installing a CO detector near gas-fired appliances provides an early warning, protecting your household from this dangerous gas.
acceptedAnswer.description: Carbon monoxide safety with gas appliances requires proper ventilation and CO detectors. Regular flue inspections prevent dangerous, silent leaks.
